name: process-api-net11
description: Launch and supervise executable child processes on .NET 11 or later with System.Diagnostics.Process or SafeProcessHandle. DO NOT USE FOR: opening URLs in the default browser or documents in their associated application. Those are operating-system shell-association requests, not executable child-process management, even on .NET 11. DO NOT USE FOR: projects that must remain on .NET 10 or earlier. USE FOR: launching executables; preventing redirected stdout/stderr pipe deadlocks; capturing text, bytes, or interleaved lines; waiting for exit status; cancellation and timeouts; redirecting standard handles to files, pipes, or the null device; restricting handle inheritance; custom native process creation; fire-and-forget starts; parent-exit termination; terminal detachment; SafeProcessHandle and trimmer-friendly process management for NativeAOT applications.
